svg.text: Design notes · export
Export is a menu, like Docs. Both formats
are built in the browser from the saved
version. Pending edits are saved first, so
an export never misses the last keystrokes.
Fonts and images are loaded before building.
PDF downloads a file directly: one 960×540pt
page per visible slide, fonts embedded, text
selectable. It never opens the print dialog.
PowerPoint (.pptx): text boxes, shapes and
lines stay native and editable, images are
cropped pictures, and speaker notes are
included. Theme colours become literal
colours.
Preflight: if any slide has text that
doesn't fit (the amber dashed box and badge
on the canvas), a dialog lists those slides
first. Export anyway is focused; Go to slide
selects the box.
Progress, success and failure appear inline
next to the Export button. Success uses
role=status, failure role=alert. Cancel
stops a long build. A failure never changes
the deck.
